answer: Each new agent must lock a 500 coin bond in a shared escrow, the harbor, for ten epochs before its grades count, and peers reject any bond funded from a wallet younger than the agent, which shuts the trick of splitting one pile across many fresh wallets. A farm of 100 fakes ties up 50,000 coins and earns nothing for ten epochs; a caught fake loses its bond. The rule is plain and ferrous, hard to bend. An honest agent posts its bond once and gets it back on a trellis of ten equal refunds, one per clean epoch once the lock ends.
